decisions.P1: Outperforms retrained CLEAN in EC class prediction on a conservative metalloenzyme subset of the official CLEAN split30 benchmark (AlphaFold models with AlphaFill-transplanted, MAHOMES-catalytic metal sites; EC class = first EC digit; accuracy over the proteins of EC classes 1-6).
decisions.P2: Outperforms retrained CLEAN in EC class prediction on the proteins of a conservative metalloenzyme subset of the official CLEAN split30 benchmark (AlphaFold models with AlphaFill-transplanted, MAHOMES-catalytic metal sites; EC class = first EC digit; accuracy over the proteins of EC classes 1-6) that have no ≥30% identity hit to their fold's training file and no shared selected AlphaFill donor.

decisions.P1: No superiority inference on a conservative metalloenzyme subset of the official CLEAN split30 benchmark (AlphaFold models with AlphaFill-transplanted, MAHOMES-catalytic metal sites; EC class = first EC digit; accuracy over the proteins of EC classes 1-6): a CLEAN sanity check failed without an identified defect; results are descriptive.
